note: The COMPRESSED-style ratchet. sass-spec ships dart-sass's expanded output as a case's only expectation, so `pass` here is measured against spec/COMPRESSED_EXPECT.txt instead: per-case digests of the compressed CSS dart-sass 1.104.1 emits for the same cases (spec/gen_compressed.py). error_expected is style-independent and matches spec/BASELINE.json exactly. The gap to that file's pass count -- 11509 vs 11615 -- is 106 cases whose expanded CSS is byte-exact and whose compressed CSS is not. 62 of them are cases where dart-sass 1.104.1's own expanded output no longer matches the expectation sass-spec ships, so they cannot pass both ratchets at once; the other 44 are real compressed-serialization divergences, and two mechanisms cover most of them: a value we preserve as an unquoted STRING carries one spelling for both styles (a degenerate legacy color, 8 cases), and the legacy rgb()/hsl() form choice picks a different spelling from dart's (21). Raise this number, never lower it; bump this file in the same commit as the fix.
